start.title: Where are we going today?
start.form: Fill in manually, step by step
start.lead: Just tell it like you would tell a friend. Captain asks for the rest, then prepares your boarding pass and a day-by-day plan.
greetings: Who is coming along this time?
Someone uses a wheelchair? Just note it.
Halal, vegetarian, allergies: I count them all.

trip.title: Where, when, and what kind of trip?
trip.hint: Route, dates, and pace in one step. More than one destination is fine.

crew.title: Who is coming?
crew.hint: Add each person, then tap their character to set a name and their needs.

budget.title: What is the total budget?
budget.hint: For everyone. Enter Rupiah or US dollars and the other is worked out for you.

extras.title: Anything else Captain should know?
extras.hint: Optional. The more you add, the better the plan fits.

deck.previewNote: This is a preview. Finish the questions to continue.

crew.empty: No one yet. Start with the buttons above.
crew.selectHint: Tap a character to set their name and needs.

paceHints.relaxed: 2 to 3 activities a day, plenty of breaks.
paceHints.packed: 4 to 5 activities a day, making the most of the time.

ticket.draftTitle: Your boarding pass is not complete yet.
ticket.hint: Check it first. Tap any part to change it.
ticket.meetHint: Some wishes in this group clash. We'll find the middle ground first, then make the plan.

titles.access: {activity}: not everyone can join in comfortably.
titles.pace: A packed pace is too much for some.
titles.time: More wishes than there is time for.

hints.access: Some want this, and for others an activity like this is hard on what they need. Pick the middle ground that suits your group.
hints.pace: The group chose a packed pace, but some need breaks. Pick how to share it out.
hints.time: {wishes} wishes are must-haves, and there is time for about {slots}. Pick how to share it out.

adaptBody.themePark: A park with step-free routes, plenty of seats, and shows to watch sitting down. The visit is kept to about 3 hours.
adaptBody.nature: Nature without the hike: flat paths, a viewing deck, or a garden with toilets close by.
adaptBody.shopping: A calmer place to shop, at a quiet hour, with somewhere to sit every few stores.
adaptBody.food: Places whose menu suits every diet, so the whole group still eats at one table.

adapt.title: Go together, a version for everyone
adapt.cost: Those who wanted it get a lighter version, not the full one.

split.title: Split up for a while, then regroup
split.body: Those who want it go for about 3 hours, and the others go somewhere calm nearby. Everyone meets again for a meal.
split.cost: The group is apart for that time, and children or anyone who needs help must have an adult with them.

swap.title: Swap it for something everyone can join
swap.body: This activity stays out of the plan. Captain finds something else that is comfortable for all.
swap.cost: Those who wanted it give this wish up.

breaks.title: Stay packed, with a fixed break
breaks.body: The packed pace stays, with a rest of about 90 minutes around midday for everyone.

split.title: Some rest, some carry on
split.body: Around midday those who need rest go back to the lodging and the others carry on. Everyone meets again for dinner.
split.cost: The group is apart at midday, and whoever rests needs someone with them.

slow.title: Relaxed for everyone
slow.body: The pace changes to relaxed: 2 to 3 activities a day with plenty of breaks.

turns.title: Take turns, everyone gets theirs
turns.body: Every wish gets its turn, each with less time than usual.
turns.cost: Each visit is shorter and the days feel fuller.

oneEach.title: One wish each first
oneEach.body: Each person is sure of one of their wishes. The rest go in if time is left.
oneEach.cost: Whoever has many wishes is only sure of one.

split.title: Split up by wish
split.body: The group divides into smaller groups for half a day, then regroups.
split.cost: Not every moment is shared, and children need an adult with them.

ledger.title: Who gives way
ledger.hint: Fills in from your picks so far.
ledger.flag: {name} gives way at {count} clashes. Try another way through one of them, so it isn't always them.
ledger.principle: A need is never traded away. Only wishes meet in the middle.

summary.title: The middle ground in this plan

result.title: Your trip plan
result.saveFailed: The plan wasn't saved to My Trips. Check your connection, then try again.

custom.full: That makes {count}. Remove one to add another.

pass.ageHint: The age group follows the age.

itinerary.title: {destination} itinerary

rest.title: Rest
rest.detail: A break at the accommodation before continuing.

afternoon.title: Afternoon out
